confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are the strongest, drawn from secondary Numbeo-based and Italy-wide figures with snapshots from 2026. Coffee rests on Italy-wide and Florence data plus a thin Pisa expat-area point. Beer, cocktail and wine are weak: beer comes from one Italy-wide guide, cocktail is a blend of thin Pisa data and a beer-linked estimate, and wine has no Pisa data, so it is set from the local beer relationship. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, not from live listings or searches. EUR values were converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.15 EUR per USD, which I did not source; the server should apply its own conversion if it differs. The RBA observation found is dated 2026-03-20 and could not be confirmed as the latest published as of 2026-11-19, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Tuscan tourist city. Restaurant and coffee levels are cross-checked against Italy-wide averages and Florence/Numbeo-style Tuscan figures, with Pisa-specific data where available. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the local draft-beer price. Accommodation is compared to general knowledge of comparable Tuscan cities such as Lucca and Siena in peak summer.
